source_row.rationale: Regular insulin is the only insulin type approved for IV administration, and an IV regular insulin infusion is the preferred approach in DKA management, providing precise, titratable dosing to closely control the resolution of hyperglycemia and ketosis.
source_row.source_detail: IV Regular Insulin as Preferred DKA Treatment
source_row.stem: A nurse administers an IV regular insulin infusion for a client in diabetic ketoacidosis (DKA). This is the preferred approach because:
